results.title: LOCKED GROOVE
results.overview: A hand-drawn abstract audiovisual work that explores repetition as a visual and sonic trance. Composed of simple geometric shapes and inspired by pareidolia, it invites viewers to discover hidden forms and evolving patterns.

results.title: Spirit Chasers
results.overview: By generating image from sound, the film imagines landscape as something transmitted, remembered, and continually re-formed rather than simply seen. The film begins with an original audiovisual composition whose oscillator trace is screen-captured and used as the underlying structure for the image.

results.title: When Flowers Dream of Us
results.overview: After the explosion, only silence remains. The land is cracked, the roots exposed, the air heavy with dust. Red flowers once covered this place. Now only ash and the memory of their color. A voice speaks in ʿAsfouri, the lost language of birds, calling out to the soil, to what might still listen. There are no people left, only the echo of his words scattered through the wind. When we are gone, will the flowers grow again?

results.title: Isky
results.overview: ISKY follows racing pioneer Ed Iskenderian and the fearless gearheads who turned hot-rodding into a cultural revolution. From humble beginnings to motorsports legend, Edward helped redefine speed and American car culture.

results.title: Vincent Price: What Keeps Us Alive
results.original_title: Vincent Price: What Keeps Us Alive
results.overview: The fully authorized Vincent Price documentary reveals far more than the man behind Hollywood’s master of the macabre. It traces a life of elegant contradictions: a classically trained actor who redefined screen villainy with charm and intelligence, an erudite art lover and seasoned gourmand who found equal joy in low-budget horror and high culture, and—ironically, in his later years—a warm, avuncular patriarch to generations who grew up on his films, television appearances, and iconic voice. Through rare archives and deeply personal interviews, the film explores how Price embraced this unexpected cultural role, transforming from a suave antagonist into a beloved mentor figure whose presence felt both timeless and reassuring.

results.title: Ghost Stories
results.overview: A librarian is closing up the library to only find out that they aren't alone.

results.title: Changul: The Grip
results.overview: Set against the backdrop of the Gen-Z movement and the circumstances leading up to it, the film portrays a young generation refusing to remain silent in the face of growing challenges and despair.

results.title: Dirty Laundry

results.title: Izhakalkkappuram
results.overview: In an ancestral home, Dr. Ananth Sivan, an ageing Gandhian scholar, holds firmly to his lifelong beliefs, while his filmmaker daughter Karthi begins to question his convictions. Through their everyday interactions, their relationship unfolds as they navigate the delicate space between ideals, belief, and empathy.

results.title: Love, Patrick: Nothing is Impossible
results.overview: A documentary that charts the meteoric rise of Patrick Kelly, an openly gay African-American fashion designer who took the 1980s industry by storm. The film follows his journey from the segregated South to Paris, where he made history as the first American admitted into the prestigious Chambre Syndicale de la Haute Couture. Infused with his queer, camp aesthetic, Kelly's joyful collections used vibrant buttons and boldly weaponized racist stereotypes to celebrate Black beauty. The film highlights how his intersectional identity as a gay Black man shaped his radical vision, captivating icons from Grace Jones to Madonna. However, the film also confronts the devastating toll of the AIDS crisis, documenting Kelly's tragic death from complications of the disease in 1990 at just 35. Through rare archives, it delivers an intimate portrait of a queer pioneer who shattered barriers of race, sexuality, and fashion.

results.title: Not a Single Flower
results.overview: In the house where Hilda grew up, time seems to have stood still. The spaces once inhabited by her family now appear empty. Forty-eight years later, Hilda revisits her memories and shares her story with us.

results.title: Betty
results.overview: Upon discovering her grandmother Betty’s poems, Oriana attempts to piece together her image in order to understand her own identity. Delving into her family’s past, she reflects on legacy, family, and absence. What remains of us when we leave?

results.title: Before it Dissapears
results.overview: Amidst the harmonious coexistence of water, emptiness, and time, there lies a town on the banks of the Uruguay River called Liebig—a place where beauty and neglect, fact and conjecture, water, children and the elderly, memories, stories, night, fish, and fire all mingle, alongside a reality suspended in time.

results.title: The Return of Magnus Kirt
results.overview: Magnus Kirt is one throw away from the world title when his shoulder dislocates before the eyes of millions. A years-long struggle forces him to ask: what does a comeback mean when you can never return to the way you were?

results.title: She Did It
results.overview: After a suicide attempt, a fragile young woman awakens to find her boyfriend claiming her dead body is in their bathtub.
